annotations.title: Find a tool for a job

description: Find which of this service's 671 tools does a job. Say the job in plain words ("current weather in Paris", "text of a PDF", "is this wallet sanctioned") and get up to five tools by default (pass count for more, up to ten), best match first, each with its name for call_tool, what it does, its price and its required inputs. Free; call it before call_tool whenever you do not already know the tool's name.

need.description: The job in plain words, for example: current weather in Paris
